subject: Aligning demo & 30-day trial plan — HealthScope discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Connor O’Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healthscope.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning demo & 30-day trial plan — HealthScope discovery follow-up

Hi Samir and Emily,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great context on where HealthScope wants to pilot LLM-assisted triage for intake forms. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the evaluation kickoff: 

- Goal: 30-day evaluation to validate a 1) throughput/latency profile at typical daily volume, 2) prompt set quality for triage labels, and 3) cost per 1k tokens under Redwood’s batching/quantization profile.
- Success criteria (initial): >= 85% label match against your manual triage for top 3 categories; median latency < 250ms for 512-token requests; cost target < $0.30 per 1k tokens. Please flag changes.
- Next meeting: technical deep dive + kickoff (30-45m) where our SE will validate data access, SSO, and prompt/eval logistics.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 6/8, 10:00–10:30
- Tue 6/8, 15:00–15:45
- Wed 6/9, 09:00–09:45

If those don't work, share two times that do.

Attachments: HealthScope_30d_trial_plan.pdf (draft trial agenda and roles).

What I'd like from you by kickoff if possible:
- A sample prompt set (10-30 representative prompts with expected labels) so we can pre-run quick checks.
- Any compliance gating (IP/PHI) notes and preferred SSO provider.

I'll loop Marissa for commercial/contracting touchpoints and Stephanie for the SE deep dive.

Thanks,
Connor O
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
cal: https://cal.link/redwood/connor/30m

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healthscope.com>
To: Connor O’Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Ortiz <emily.ortiz@healthscope.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo & 30-day trial plan — HealthScope discovery follow-up

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. That captures our goals well. A few quick notes: 

- Success criteria look good, although our clinical lead prefers a slightly higher precision threshold for the "urgent" bucket (target 90%); happy to discuss on the kickoff.
- We can provide a sanitized sample prompt set; Emily will send a CSV with 25 examples.
- SSO: we use Okta; please confirm Redwood supports SAML SSO or whether we need a service account for the initial trial.

Availability: Tue 6/8 at 15:00 PST works best for our team. Emily will own the calendar invite.

Samir
Director of Product | HealthScope

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@healthscope.com>, Connor O’Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning demo & 30-day trial plan — HealthScope discovery follow-up

Appreciate the quick reply, Samir. I’ll handle commercial alignment. A couple items from my side: 

- I'll send a short SOW (non-binding) that outlines the 30-day scope and typical deliverables; that will accompany the trial paperwork.
- Can you confirm if procurement needs a PO or a signed agreement prior to the trial? For many pilots we do a trial agreement + mutual NDA; we can waive the invoice step for the pilot if needed.

Stephanie — can you prepare a short checklist for the deep dive (SSO, sample data access method, perf expectations, and any redaction guidance)?

Connor — confirming we have Tue 6/8, 15:00–15:45 PST as the kickoff. I’ll follow up with the SOW and a one-page trial summary after this thread.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Director | Redwood Inference
Attachment: HealthScope_30d_trial_plan.pdf

Perfect — thanks Emily and Samir. Confirming kickoff: Tue Jun 8, 2027 | 15:00–15:45 PST (30–45m) — Technical deep dive + trial kickoff. Calendar invite received.

Quick agenda for the kickoff (we’ll put this in the invite):
1) Introductions and roles (5m)
2) Trial goals & success criteria validation (5m)
3) Data & SSO checklist (10m)
4) Prompt set & eval plan (10m)
5) Commercial touchpoints and next steps (5m)

Next actions: 
- Connor: pre-seed a small validation run against the prompt set once Emily’s file is ingested (I’ll share results in the kickoff note).
- Stephanie: bring SE checklist and initial plan for SAML Okta integration.
- Marissa: circulate SOW and trial summary + any procurement asks.

Links: HubSpot record: https://hubspot.company/record/HS-3487; booking: https://cal.link/redwood/connor/30m
